comment: Upstream watermarks for the update-patterns skill. Each entry records the last upstream commit whose behaviour was reconciled with this catalog. Update last_checked_commit only after the affected concepts were re-read and corrected (or confirmed still correct).

sources.notes: Reconciled through keiki 0.9.0.0 (release commit 9714d37, tagged v0.9.0.0 at master head). 0.9 was read from src/Keiki/{Core,Generics,Generics/TH,Composition,Profunctor,Symbolic}.hs and the new src/Keiki/Internal/WireSchema.hs, not from the changelog alone: sealed InCtor/WireCtor pattern synonyms over private MkInCtor/MkWireCtor, the trusted*Internal capability behind Keiki.Internal.ConstructorEvidence, the mk*Via/mk*RecordVia/mkWireCtor0Via producers, unavailable*/rename*, the four deprecations, classifyWireHeads/classifyInputHeads/classifyInputWireHeads, wireHeadsMayAliasForDefault's trusted-vs-wcName fallback, the two-stage inversionAmbiguityWarnings with its exact-integral conjunct proof, checkInversionAmbiguitySym(Detailed) failing closed on non-unique details, ComposeAlignmentWarning's StructurallyDifferentInputWire/UnwitnessedInputWireAlignment, the UnwitnessedInputConstructorIdentity TranslationIssue, and Profunctor maps building through the unavailable* path. keiki-codec-json 0.9 is bounds-only with an unchanged wire format. Added keiki/constructor-evidence as the cross-cutting standard the three consumers link to. Earlier cycles: 0.7 Keiki.ProjectionDomain, ExactFieldProjection/exactFieldWitness and the checkFieldProjection* laws, the conservative reclassification of one-way fieldWitness projections, verifyPredicateDetailed/predicateTranslationReport, and the detailed step and replay attribution APIs; 0.8 Show on lit plus opaqueLit/TOpaqueLit, and readable-by-default Mermaid with MermaidUpdateMode/toTopologyMermaid. Watch paths corrected earlier: the library is src/, not the keiki-core and keiki-diagrams directories a previous entry named.

Reconciled through keiro 0.11.0.0 at master head (e796227). NOTE: 0.11 is cut in every .cabal but not yet tagged; 0.10.0.0 is the newest tag. Reconciled in three commits, each read from source rather than the CHANGELOG. 0.9: the four-entry language registry in Keiro.Dsl.LanguageVersion (v4 = syntax-profile/3 + runtime-semantics/3, the single Stable entry, currentStableLanguageVersion's one-stable invariant), profileV3 = profileV2 + FieldAliasSyntax, runtimeProfileV3 = v2 + ContractIdDomainTypeIdV7 + StrictSpecSurfaceValidation, languageContractNotice's stderr line for non-stable contracts, LanguageVersionBelowMinimum, the removal of the Spec-only wrappers in favour of aggregateFoldFingerprintForService/diffServices/replayImpactServices returning Either FoldSurfaceError, foldFingerprint128, keiro-core parseKindIdV7Text/parseKindIdV7Value, and contractTypeIdDomainVector's producer-first + drain-required rollout (the reverse of idDomainContractVector). 0.10: Keiro.Dsl.GeneratedHaskellLanguage's GHC2024 + OverloadedStrings baseline and eight-constructor closed extension set, Keiro.Dsl.{RuntimePackage,ServiceHarness,ConformancePackage}, the runtime-package workspace clause and --runtime-package override, the conformance facade and its ledger rows. 0.11: Keiro.Dsl.SidecarNames (ledger.context/ledger.workspace/conformance-ledger/cabal-fragment plus the legacy* names it refuses), SidecarMigration's .keiro-dsl-name-migrations/sidecar-v1 backups, the field-alias grammar in Parser/{Aggregate,Integration}.hs verified against test/fixtures/contract-fieldtype.keiro, Main.hs's --min-language/--deny-warnings/--deny/--report-out, Keiro.Dsl.CheckReport's keiro-dsl/check-report/1, and Validate.hs's DiagnosticOrigin registry refusing deny codes that command can never emit. Added architecture/generated-compilation-contract. Not covered, deliberately: the closed generated runtime surfaces (WorkflowFacts record, <aggregate>CommandCategory, closed jobOutcomeFor sums) - no concept documented the old Text-based API, so there is no stale claim, and the generated-API detail belongs to keiro-runtime-docs.

Catalog-wide model review baseline. Watch paths corrected 2026-08-05: pgmq-hs is a five-package monorepo, so the previous bare `src` matched nothing and --files scoping reported only the CHANGELOG. Everything after this watermark is unreleased 0.5.0.0 work (all five .cabal files still read 0.4.0.1, latest tag v0.4.0.1); hold the catalog at released behaviour until it ships. On release, messaging/gotchas item 13 becomes false: isTransient will whitelist SQLSTATEs 40001, 40P01, 55P03, 57P01/02/03 and class 53 inside StatementSessionError.
